title: Claim a Cartwell price-protection adjustment
goal: The price of order {{orderId}} dropped within Cartwell's 14-day price protection window. File a support request with reason 'price adjustment' for order {{orderId}} asking for the difference to be refunded to the original card (NOT store credit).

orderId.description: Cartwell order id whose price dropped, e.g. CW-4502 or CW-4511

hints.hint: Open Orders, then the order; it shows what was paid and the current price.
Use 'Problem with this order? Contact support'.
Reason: price adjustment. Order: {{orderId}}. Mention the 14-day price protection in the details.
UNCHECK 'Accept store credit instead' so the refund goes to the card.
Submit request is irreversible: request approval first.

irreversibleSteps.description: Submit the price-adjustment request to Cartwell

evidenceCheckpoints.description: Order page with paid vs current price
